name: color-picker
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only Color Picker component for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus Components extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA` in upstreams/dioxus-components/inventory.md and excluded from shadcn parity tracking. HSV saturation/value drag surface with keyboard arrow-key navigation and accessible per-axis range inputs (AreaThumbSaturationInput/AreaThumbValueInput). The M3 migration queue's dependency note said this item composes label/popover/slider; reading the actual upstream primitive source found it only depends on the already-owned move_interaction/pointer modules (reused unmodified from Wave 2's Slider import), not those three registry items -- a real correction recorded per the M1 lesson to verify against source, not the queue's one-line notes. Requires the `palette` crate directly (matching upstream's own public HSV color type in its props), same as any upstream consumer.
